_note: bodybutter shares bodylotion's dict table (sincere-hearth-273704.bodylotion.bodylotion_dict), QA table (bodylotion.product_id_dict_qa) and filter table (bodylotion.filter_bodylotion_lazada). Pattern verified 2026-09-16 against 'body butter' rows in that dict; identical to dict_patterns/bodylotion.json.

packsize.note: For bundle_type='multipack' the packsize carries a multiplier suffix: '{gramasi} {satuan} x {N} pcs' (N = bundle_quantity). Bundles/sets use packsize=gramasi=satuan='Set'; unknown/multi-size listings use packsize='Multi Size', gramasi='Multi', satuan='Multi Variant'.

sku_type_complete.note: sub_brand already begins with the brand, e.g. brand='Herborist' -> sub_brand='Herborist Body Butter Mango With Shea Butter' -> sku_type_complete='Herborist Body Butter Mango With Shea Butter 80 gr'.

keywords.note: keywords = sku_type_complete plus a single trailing space.
